items.name: Cheese pizza (thin-crust flatbread, 3 small pieces: crust, tomato sauce, mozzarella)
items.preparation: baked, cut into small square/triangular pieces

scale_cues: Large white square dinner plate (assumed ~26-28 cm across) on a cafeteria tray; each pizza piece spans roughly 8-10 cm, about a quarter of the plate width.
assumptions: Pizza is plain cheese with tomato sauce, no meat toppings
Thin to medium crust, about 1 cm thick, around 50-55 g per piece
Energy density about 265 kcal/100 g and 11 g protein/100 g for cheese pizza
Any oil is part of the pizza and included in its estimate
The partially visible dish at the left edge is a separate plate and is excluded
